say:1:1360213001:1.text: Wait a minute! I think my doppelganger said something before I passed out!
say:1:1360213001:1.source_cn: 我想起来了，在我被暗影包裹，即将失去意识之前，我听到扮...

say:4:1360213003:1.text: Ah... I'm not important. Who YOU are is what truly matters, don't you think, fluffy white guy?
say:4:1360213003:1.source_cn: 啊——我是什么不重要，你是什么才比较重要吧，毛茸茸的大...

say:5:1360213004:1.text: I thought you were a Mauler... Do you have any idea how fascinating those guys are?
say:5:1360213004:1.source_cn: 我还以为你会是蛮血那边的呢……真是的，你知不知道那边的...

say:6:1360213005:1.text: They're a bunch of blockheads who only know how to throw punches. Just drop them the tiniest clue, and they'll jump on it.
say:6:1360213005:1.source_cn: 他们没脑子、傻乎乎，只知道打架，稍微给一点小线索就会上钩——

say:7:1360213006:1.text: They can be pretty annoying, but they're a real blast!
say:7:1360213006:1.source_cn: 虽然很容易让人厌烦，但是找乐子也非常容易！

say:8:1360213007:1.text: But... you're different. I can't believe you actually tricked me! You have fur like the Maulers, but you're smart unlike them... How's that possible?
say:8:1360213007:1.source_cn: 结果，结果你居然骗我！长着一身皮毛，居然还长了脑子？！

say:9:1360213008:1.text: Ah!!! This doesn't make any sense!
say:9:1360213008:1.source_cn: 啊啊啊啊啊，不合理，不合理！

say:11:1360213009:1.text: That fellow started talking to himself. He was laughing at first, but the next moment, he flew into a rage...
say:11:1360213009:1.source_cn: 那家伙自言自语，一开始笑，但转眼间就开始大怒……

say:12:1360213010:1.text: The last thing I heard before blacking out was his scream.
say:12:1360213010:1.source_cn: 在我失去意识前，还能听到他的尖叫。

say:14:1360213011:0.text: Well, Berial's mood swings are just as notorious as his madness.
say:14:1360213011:0.source_cn: 的确，贝利尔的喜怒无常和他的癫狂同样有名。

say:15:1360213012:1.text: Anyway, I think we can gather some clues from his ramblings.
say:15:1360213012:1.source_cn: 不过，这些疯话里，也遗留给了吾等线索。

choice_prompt:16:1360213012.text: Anyway, I think we can gather some clues from his ramblings.
choice_prompt:16:1360213012.source_cn: 不过，这些疯话里，也遗留给了吾等线索。

say:17:1360213013:1.text: That's a good one. Though Maulers can be found all across Esperia, I remember a place where Hypogeans were once sealed.
say:17:1360213013:1.source_cn: 嗯，尽管蛮血部落的子民遍布各地，但有一处，吾记得曾有恶...
say:17:1360213013:1.male: That's a good one. Though Maulers can be found all across Esperia, I remember a place where Hypogeans were once sealed.
say:17:1360213013:1.female: That's a good one. Though Maulers can be found all across Esperia, I remember a place where Hypogeans were once sealed.

say:18:1360213014:1.text: It's plausible that Berial is doing all of this to free his peers.
say:18:1360213014:1.source_cn: 若贝利尔的真实目标是为了解除同伴的封印，那他一连串的行...

say:19:1360213015:1.text: ...But then again, I wouldn't be surprised if he was doing this for no reason.
say:19:1360213015:1.source_cn: ……不过，如果是贝利尔，也的确存在他根本没有任何动机的...

say:20:1360213016:1.text: Now, here's the plan—Merlin, since you're familiar with Berial's behavior, I want you to track him down using the clues.
say:20:1360213016:1.source_cn: 那么，接下来这样办吧。梅林，汝熟悉贝利尔的行为模式，希...
say:20:1360213016:1.male: Now, here's the plan—Merlin, since you're familiar with Berial's behavior, I want you to track him down using the clues.
say:20:1360213016:1.female: Now, here's the plan—Merlin, since you're familiar with Berial's behavior, I want you to track him down using the clues.

say:21:1360213017:1.text: As for me, I'll stay here to purify any lingering corruption. Windwhisperer, I need your keen ears.
say:21:1360213017:1.source_cn: 而吾会留在此处，净化可能存在的污染残留——年轻的风语者...

say:23:1360213018:1.text: Me? Hmm, as much as I'd love to travel with <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know what's more important.
say:23:1360213018:1.male: Me? Hmm, as much as I'd love to travel with <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know what's more important.
say:23:1360213018:1.female: Me? Hmm, as much as I'd love to travel with <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know what's more important.

say:24:1360213019:1.text: You can count on me, Dunlingr! Let's search around Cedartown together!
say:24:1360213019:1.source_cn: 请放心地交给我，顿里尔大人，我们一道在雪松镇附近仔细排...

say:25:1360213020:1.text: The Frozen Paw is badly affected!
say:25:1360213020:1.source_cn: 白熊温泉旅店那里就十分严重！

say:26:1360213021:1.text: Very well, Merlin. I'll leave the hunt for Berial to you and your familiars.
say:26:1360213021:1.source_cn: 很好，那么追缉贝利尔的行动，就拜托汝与汝之使魔了，梅林。
say:26:1360213021:1.male: Very well, Merlin. I'll leave the hunt for Berial to you and your familiars.
say:26:1360213021:1.female: Very well, Merlin. I'll leave the hunt for Berial to you and your familiars.

say:27:1360213022:1.text: Here, take this—it carries my magic and can suppress and purify corrupted energy.
say:27:1360213022:1.source_cn: 此物留有我的魔力，可以镇压及净化扭曲的魔力，交由你使用吧。
say:27:1360213022:1.male: Here, take this—it carries my magic and can suppress and purify corrupted energy.
say:27:1360213022:1.female: Here, take this—it carries my magic and can suppress and purify corrupted energy.

choice_prompt:28:1360213022.female: Here, take this—it carries my magic and can suppress and purify corrupted energy.

say:29:1360213023:1.text: Let's get moving. We can't let the Hypogeans run amok on this land!
say:29:1360213023:1.source_cn: 接下来，就准备行动。绝不可让恶魔继续堂皇行走于大陆之上！
